content: Fiyongol Chol Hammalel Milayel Grape We

Iwe ngo Jesus sa hapatpat ngalir le ye teptap fiyong, le ye sor bo, “Ye mel semal mal le ye foru sew milayel grape bo yal iwe sa yorora. Iwe sa kilngi sew lib bo liliyel wungungul chael grape. Iwe ngo sa hasu sew imw bo imwer re matmetal milay we. Iwe ngo yesa hamler re matmat kowe iyang ngo yesa ligdi molwe bugtal sala malekah.
Yodwe yela masow grape kowe uwal milay we iyang, ngo mal we sa fangloh semal boy kowe lol irer chol hammalel milay we bo rebe fang ngali mele yildil mo irel uwal milay we.
Iwe ngo ir re matmat kowe re hasi resa lliy boy we, resa hatefaeli le tor mele re ngaley.
Iwe ngo mal we yal milay we sa wol fangloh semal boy kowe lol irer rechokwe. Iwe ngo ir re hasi resa wwodu molwe chemal ngo re hafohoyu fedaley.

Mal we sa wol fangloh semal boy kowe lol. Iwe ngo ir rechokwe re hasi chog resa limeseloh. Ye retloh boy kowe lol mal we le iye sengal chog mekla re faor ngalir, le tot ikla re hafohoyur ngo tot ikla re limeserloh.
Iwe sala tarmal we chog spegil lol we ye kkel yal hachangi mele yela mel diy. La hartal loh ngo sa fangloh molwe lol ngo sa sor bo, ‘Ye tugul lal depey le rebe hasrowu mele layi.’
Rechokwe rela wiri chog molwe lol ngo resa sor bo, ‘Iye molwe lol yeramtawe bugtal mele. Ha rodoh sibe limeseloh bo sibe bugtali mele bugtal!’
Iwe resa ddorfi tarmal we resa limeseloh resa pedawey mo yilgul milay we.”
Iwe ngo Jesus sa kasiyar bo, “Meda mele mal we yal milay we bele foru? Ye bele budoh llir rechokwe ngo yesa ngaler sibis milay we.
Ha ted yawli mwo mele mo lal babior we ye santus?

content.text: ‘Feas we chol hasul imw re pedaloh bo tor pelal
ila feas la sala mel le
Mele ila Samol mele ye foru le be iye sengal;

content: Mokwe metael yalor Jews resa luluwaley rebe ddorfi Jesus bo resa gola le fiyongor molwe yesa kangalur. Iwe ngo re metagu buwa we, iwe resa ligdi Jesus resa loh.
Kasiyel Kofal Ffagel Paliyel Raeg
Resa fangloh tot Pharisees kawe mo tot mokwe choluwal Yerodes bo re bela hapagu Jesus ngal tot kasiy.

Resa budoh irel resa sor bo, “Sensey, hamem ha gola le ye katos mekla ho sosor ngo ho tela sar mmerahrah mwo irel makla yarmat re luluwaley. Ho hafidgir loh chog panger yarmat. Ho sala foloyu ngal yarmat mala ye katos le depel Deus. Kangalugmem hare ye fel mo irel Hatobtob we yach le sibe ffaeg paliyel raeg ngal mala Llulupal Roma? Sibe ffaeg hare si towe ffaeg?”
Yodwe chog ngo Jesus yesa gola luluwal kowe yar. Iwe ngo sa kasiyar bo, “Meda mele ha luluwaley habe hapaguyey iyang? Ha hasidoh sefaes salpiy kowe silver bo iy be kamahoy.”
Iwe resa hasidoh sefaes salpiy silver resa ngaley. Iwe ngo Jesus sa kasiyar bo, “Yongol itey mo idel itey mele?” Iwe ngo ir resa sor bo, “Yongol mo idel molwe Llulupal Roma.”
Jesus sa kangalur bo, “Hare ila sengal ngo hasa ngaley mala Llulupal Roma mekla lamliyal ngo hasa ngaley Deus ikala lamliyel Deus.” Iwe re sala toglaloh mele rebe sor irel Jesus.
Kasiyel Kofal Molow Tefael Mo Irel Maes
Tot mo irer Sadducees kowe rema sor bo tor mele molow tefael mo irel maes, re budoh irel Jesus resa kangalu bo,

“Sensey, Moses ye tefadiy hatobtob le bo yach ngo ye sor bo: ‘Hare la mes semal mal ngo tor layur mo mala ril, ngo molwe bisil mal we sa mes be rili fefel we, bo bela yor layur ngo yebe yitilir bo lol mal we bisil we sa mes.’
Ye mel fismol bisbis ngo ila chog mol yarmat mele yor ril ngo yela mesloh ngo tor lol.
Iwe molwe harumalel yarmat sala rili fefel we ngo yela mesloh mal we ngo wol tor lol. Ye wol ila sengal iwe hasolmolol yarmat.
Pangerloh bisbis we fismol ngo re riliy fefel we. Iwe panger ngo re mesloh le tor chog layur. Yela wol miril loh ngo yesa moch mes fefel we.
Itey semal mo irer irel yodla re bela molow tefael mo irel maes le be mel bo ril fefel we? Pangerloh ngo iwe re rili fefel we.”
Jesus sa kangalur bo, “Ila lepal yami machey! Ha gola fal? Mil mala ha temdaf irel yadol Babior we ye Santus ngo ha togla mala kkelel Deus.
Yodla chomes re bela molow tefael mo irel maes ngo re bele hafedeg ngalir chog angelus kala wol laeng le retema riri.

Iwe ngo kofal yar yarmat molow tefael mo irel maes: ha ted yawli mwo molwe kaptal ire we ye bbulbul we ye mel lal Babior we yael Moses? Ye teftaf iyang we Deus ye kangalu Moses bo, ‘Ngang mele yael Abraham mo Isaac mo Jacob Deus.’
Iy yar chomolow Deus ngo te iy yar chomes Deus. Hami ila sa paleng yami machey!”
Hatobtob We Ye Hartal Palleng

Ye mel semal sensel Hatobtob we loboswe le ye rongrong mokwe re kekapta. Ye rongrong tefaelel kasiy kowe yar Sadducees kowe le ye bung. Iwe sa budoh irel Jesus sa kasiya bo, “Ifa sew mo luwul mokwe yadol hatobtob we le ye palleng fal?”
Jesus sa sor bo, “Mala ye hartal palleng fal ila iye sengal: ‘Ha talenga hami yeramtal Israel! Samol la yach Deus ila iy chog mele yach Samol.
Habe hachangi Samol le yami Deus mo lal dipmi, mo pangal loh ngulmi, kkelmi mo yami luluwal.’
Mala harwowal le ye wol palleng fal, ila hobe hachangir yarmat le be wochog yam gel hachangug. Tor sew mo luwul yadol hatobtob we le ye palleng fal mo imol mele ruwow.”
Sensel Hatobtob we sa kangal Jesus bo, “Ila sengal ho sensey! Ye katos mala ho sor le Samol chog mele Iy Deus. Tor semal mo solbos bo iy loh chog.

Ila semal ngo yebe hachang Deus mo lal depal mo pangal loh yal luluwal mo pangal loh kkelal, ngo yebe hachang yarmat le be wochog yal iy hachangi wol halongol. Ye palleng pelal le sibe dabey meka ruwow mo irel Hatobtob we mo imol mala sibe taep maligach mael, mo maligach kala tot le sima fang ngal Deus mo woal altar.”
Yodwe Jesus yela gola le ye momay mokwe sensel Hatobtob we ye sor, ngo sa kangalu bo, “Gel ila ho tay ddaw tang mala Lamliyel Deus.” La wol miril chog mele ngo tayor mele re chil mechal kasiya Jesus.
Kasiyel Kofal Kristus
Irel yodwe Jesus ye fofoloy lal Templum we, ngo sa kasiyar bo, “Ifa sengal chog ngo mokwe sensel Hatobtob we re sala sor bo Kristus ila chol daowe yael David?
Espritu Santus ye hatarma lal depel David bo yebe sor bo:

content.text: yee la hola yodla ibe yitilirlong fael pechem

content: Iy mwo David ngo ye ffesangu bo ‘Samol’. Ila be ifa sengal chog ngo Kristus sala mel bo iy semal chol daowe yael David?” Jesus Ye Hadpar Yarmat Irer Mokwe Sensel Hatobtob We (Matthew 23:1–36; Luke 20:45–47) Sew buwa re tetalenga mokwe yalol Jesus ngo ye rraey lal deper iyang.

Yodwe ye fofoloyur ngo sa kangalur bo, “Habe hafalugmi irer mokwe sensel Hatobtob we. Re dipli bo rebe dedaer fedal le re mengag irel mengag kowe ye lelay ngo re dipli bo yarmat rebe ma hasrowur mo loboka ma toa cholop doh chog yarmat iyang.
Ngo rema duwley chog lobos kala ye momay bo liliyer mo lal imwel ttey ka ngo re wol dipli bo rebe ma mel irel lobos kala liliyer chotagiyet mo irel gubul ka.
Ye ffal deper uwor fefel kala sa mes rir le rema hasi tangir bugter iwe ngo rema forurloh irel mepel kala yar le ye lelay bo yarmat rebe wiri, ila yebe hartal kkel yar hagerger.”
Maligach We Yael Fefel We Sa Mes Ril
Yodwe Jesus ye maro lengchel liliyel maligach we lal Templum we ngo ye kakemahor yarmat yar ppepe yar maligach. Ye cholop rechokla re mmwal le ye cholop salpiy le re pedalong lal kahol we.
Iwe ngo ye mel semal fefel le sa mes mala ril ngo sa kkel yal hafohoy le ye wol budoh sa pedalong rufeas kobre checha lal liliyel maligach we.
Jesus sa ffesang fengalir mokwe re dabeyal sa kangalur bo, “Ibe kangalugmi le fefel le ye hafohoy ila ye palleng mele ye pedalong lal liliyel maligach la mo imwor rechokwe tot.

Rechokla ila hal sugfed mele re hasi mo irel salpiy kala layur le ye cholop resa yetolong lal liliyel maligach la. Iwe ngo fefel la ila ye kkel yal hafohoy ngo sa fang loh lepal mala hammalel le ye mel irel bo yal maligach.”
